evidence.title: Reicon - Complete Reference for AI Agents
Reicon - Open-Source Icon Library for Designers & Developers

name: Reicon
summary: Open-source icon library with 2,700+ handcrafted SVG icons in Outline and Filled weights, free under MIT.
description: 2,700+ handcrafted icons on a 24×24 grid in Outline and Filled weights, free under MIT. Ships as tree-shakeable packages for React, Vue 3, Svelte, React Native, Flutter and vanilla JS, a CDN web component, a Figma plugin, a VS Code extension and an MCP server that lets AI agents search, view and apply icons.
contains: 2,700+ icons on a 24×24 grid in Outline and Filled weights
packages: reicon-react, reicon-vue, reicon-svelte, reicon-react-native, reiconflutter, reicon (vanilla)
CDN web component <re-icon> with size, color, rotate, flip, spin and gradient attributes
MCP server for AI agents (searchicons, viewicon, applyicon, listcategories; npx reicon-mcp)
Figma plugin and VS Code extension for browsing and inserting icons
